in_sanskrit.name: Ivanya
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Moon Goddess
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ivanya एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Ivanya is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Iva', meaning 'Ishwara', the supreme god, and 'Nayani', meaning 'goddess of eyes or the moon'. In Hindu mythology, the moon goddess is associated with the nourishing, protective, and calming energies of the moon.
